purpose: Mechanism-diverse, CVE-backed positive acquisition for human adjudication and future classifier training
selection_policy: Frozen before scanner execution. Entries were selected for independently reviewed CVE provenance, isolated pre-fix/post-fix commits, language and mechanism diversity, permissive licensing, and bounded acquisition size. Scanner outcomes must not be used to add, remove, or replace entries.
ground_truth_policy: The cited advisory and isolated security patch define the targeted known-positive mechanism in the pre-fix snapshot and its removal in the post-fix snapshot. Detector output remains untrusted and requires human adjudication; unrelated findings are not ground truth.
hosted_model_policy: All entries are public upstream source. This manifest does not authorize transmitting proprietary source to a hosted model.
